rules.text: The Viewing distance line says enlarging needed.
rules.when_true: the Viewing distance line says 'enlarging needed'
rules.when_false: the Viewing distance line says 'no enlarging needed', 'no enlarging needed yet', 'no face visible' or 'this app has no zoom control'
rules.basis: Clouclip pilot: under 30 cm for more than 5 s counts as unhealthy near work. Larger text lets you lean back.

rules.text: The Glasses line says reminder due.
rules.when_true: the Glasses line ends with 'reminder due'
rules.when_false: the Glasses line ends with 'no reminder needed'
rules.basis: Leaning in and squinting at once is a common sign of reading without your prescribed glasses.

rules.text: The Theme line says dark mode needed.
rules.when_true: the Theme line says 'mismatch, dark mode needed'
rules.when_false: the Theme line says 'no change needed'
rules.basis: A bright light page in a dark room is a common glare complaint.

rules.text: The Screen brightness line says dimming needed.
rules.when_true: the Screen brightness line says 'dimming needed'
rules.when_false: the Screen brightness line says 'no change needed', 'brightening needed' or 'not adjustable'
rules.basis: A screen much brighter than a dark room adds glare. Rule 3 (dark mode) comes first.

rules.text: The Screen brightness line says brightening needed.
rules.when_true: the Screen brightness line says 'brightening needed'
rules.when_false: the Screen brightness line says 'no change needed', 'dimming needed' or 'not adjustable'
rules.basis: A dim screen in a bright room makes you lean in and squint.

rules.text: The Near-work bout line says break is due.
rules.when_true: the Near-work bout line ends with 'break is due'
rules.when_false: the Near-work bout line ends with 'break not due yet'
rules.basis: Clouclip pilot: under 60 cm for more than 45 min counts as unhealthy near work. A 20 s far look breaks the bout.

rules.text: The Relaxed reading line says text can go back one step.
rules.when_true: the Relaxed reading line ends with 'text can go back one step'
rules.when_false: the Relaxed reading line ends with 'no change needed'
rules.basis: Undo Myrmidon's own zoom once you have read comfortably for a while.

rules.text: The Squint despite zoom line says yes.
rules.when_true: the Squint despite zoom line ends with 'yes'
rules.when_false: the Squint despite zoom line ends with 'no'
rules.basis: If enlarging text has not helped, ask you instead of guessing. At most once per 30 min.

interrupt_ok.instructions: Read the Activity line. Is it OK to interrupt the user with a prompt right now?

criteria.true: Activity says idle, between tasks, or just switched windows
criteria.false: Activity says video call, presenting or screen sharing, typing in a burst, or fullscreen video
